task: ae.ot operational transformation library for collaborative text editing
reasoning_summary: Canonical component-list TextOp with compose, transform (first argument wins insert ties), invert and cursor mapping; a Jupiter-style client state machine over a linear-history server. Tests combine literals, TP1 with unique-character provenance invariants, and 400 seeded multi-client simulations with a base+pending invariant. A 33-mutant pass killed 29; 4 survivors are justified as equivalent.
